events.verdict: Johnson (BKN) establishes himself in a defensive position alongside of Brunson (NYK) and the ensuing lower body contact is marginal as Brunson cuts towards the basket.
Anunoby (NYK) initiates contact to Johnson's (BKN) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Towns (NYK) establishes himself in a screening position in Johnson's (BKN) path and does not deliver contact.
Bridges (NYK) moves forwards into Russell (BKN), initiating illegal contact to his foot as he elevates for the jump shot attempt.
Claxton (BKN) avoids contact with Anunoby's (NYK) arm as he defends the dunk attempt.
Claxton (BKN) has his arm extended as Bridges (NYK) attempts to move around the screen, but the contact is marginal.
Brunson (NYK) and Russell (BKN) engage during the throw-in and as Brunson releases, Russell's momentum carries him backwards.
Russell (BKN) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it away from Brunson (NYK).
Russell (BKN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Johnson (BKN) makes contact to Brunson's (NYK) arm, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Achiuwa (NYK) legally contests Johnson's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Hart (NYK) grabs the rebound and does not step out of bounds before requesting a timeout.
Martin (BKN) commits a take foul on Hart (NYK).
Russell (BKN) extends his hands into Brunson (NYK), causing him to lose his balance.
Brunson (NYK) legally contests Johnson's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
